articles.title: Inside B'luru murders: Mutton curry invite, sleeping pills, TV blaring, bodies in bags
articles.description: S Indushekhar reportedly killed his wife Sunitha and six of her relatives at their rented house. Following the murders, he and his daughter disposed of the bodies in various locations. Investigators believe that financial disputes related to gold jewellery may have motivated the killings. The police have found several bodies and are investigating further connections to the crime. Indushekhar's actions stem from a long-standing marital conflict exacerbated by family support.

articles.title: ‘Severe’ season: GRAP III in force as air quality plummets; what changes from today
articles.description: GRAP III was activated in New Delhi as the air quality index continues to deteriorate significantly. The average AQI reached 382 at 4pm on Friday, prompting precautionary measures to be implemented. Areas throughout the city are already reporting severe air quality levels, particularly Punjabi Bagh and DTU. In response, certain restrictions on vehicles and construction activities have been enforced.

articles.description: In the 2026 US midterm elections, Democrats made notable gains among Latino voters, following a period of prior support for Republicans. High turnout from Latino constituents significantly impacted voting dynamics nationwide, with many responding negatively to proposed data centre projects.

articles.description: French trade unions and student groups are organizing a day of protests against rising living costs. Nationwide demonstrations have been ongoing for weeks, with participants demanding wage increases and better conditions for youth. On Monday, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu will meet with union representatives to discuss these issues.

articles.title: Why new LNG projects may not prevent a global gas crunch this winter
articles.description: Global liquefied natural gas supplies are facing unprecedented challenges due to ongoing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. The International Energy Agency reports that LNG loadings from Qatar and the UAE have decreased significantly. As a result, global LNG output is projected to fall between 10 and 25 billion cubic meters during winter. New projects in North America and other regions may partially mitigate the shortfall.

articles.title: India's forex reserves dip by $2.69 billion: What's behind the decline?
articles.description: India's foreign exchange reserves decreased by $2.691 billion, primarily due to lower foreign currency assets and gold holdings. Foreign currency assets fell by $2.088 billion, while gold reserves decreased by $559 million during the reporting week. Despite this decline, overall reserves remain higher than the levels recorded in March 2026. Year-on-year comparisons indicate a net increase in foreign exchange reserves of $27.324 billion.

articles.title: He arrived in Israel just two days earlier for a school programme; 17-year-old US student discovers a 3,300-year-old Egyptian amulet from the Bronze Age
articles.description: A 17-year-old US student, Shiloh Attoun, discovered a 3,300-year-old Egyptian-style scarab amulet during a school excursion to Tel Gezer National Park in Israel. The Late Bronze Age artefact features two cobra motifs representing an ancient Egyptian royal symbol. Archaeologists examined and dated the object before the Israel Antiquities Authority collected it for preservation. Attoun received a certificate of appreciation for reporting the discovery, which offers insights into ancient Egyptian cultural influence in the region.

articles.description: The Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education (RBSE) has announced the examination schedule for Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations. Both examinations will begin on February 16, with papers scheduled to start at 10:30 AM. Students have been advised to check their subject-wise examination dates, admit card details and examination centre information. Candidates should follow official Board notifications and school instructions for updates regarding the examination programme and avoid relying on unverified information circulated through social media.

articles.title: MHT CET Cell approaches police over alleged audio recording promising higher marks; two misleading social media posts removed
articles.description: The Maharashtra CET Cell has filed a police complaint at Mumbai's Azad Maidan Police Station over an alleged audio recording involving claims of examination centre manipulation and marks enhancement in MHT CET. The recording has been submitted to police for investigation. The CET Cell also reported removing two misleading social media posts announcing purported 2027 CET examination dates after issuing legal notices to Digital Master and Nashik-based Spectrum Academy. Students can report misinformation through its dedicated email address.

articles.title: 55 students from 11 government schools send a 2 kg research payload 35 km above Earth; Coimbatore project takes classroom science into the stratosphere
articles.description: Fifty-five students from 11 government middle schools in Tamil Nadu's Coimbatore district participated in Project Uyarvu, sending a 2 kg scientific payload to 35 km above Earth using a helium-filled high-altitude balloon. Equipped with atmospheric sensors and a particle trap, the instrument collected environmental data during its nearly three-hour flight. Around 330 more students will analyse the findings, prepare research reports and explore local environmental issues, gaining hands-on experience in atmospheric science.

articles.description: On the occasion of veteran actor Kamal Haasan's 72nd birthday, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay extended warm wishes, recognizing Haasan's outstanding contributions to both cinema and social initiatives. Fans are buzzing with excitement for the festivities and the film's release.

articles.title: Jamie Lee Curtis says she continues to talk to Rob and Michele Reiner’s kids
articles.description: Jamie Lee Curtis expressed her deep bond with the late Rob and Michele Reiner during an interview. She continues to support their children, Jake and Romy, as they navigate their grief. The actress emphasized that the family has not properly grieved yet due to ongoing legal matters. Curtis will receive the inaugural Michele and Rob Reiner Champion for Change Award at an upcoming gala.
